# Test fixtures

Small HTML/JSON pages that mimic the *structure* of the sites the scraper
reads (ipowatch.in, investorgain.com, groww.in), so the parsers can be tested
offline.

All company names, people and text in these files are **fictional**, and
only the table layout needed by the parsers is kept. The numbers are sample
values. They are not copies of any site's content.
